item.title: Fixing Empty Lists: Handling Asynchronous Data Fetching in Cloud Firestore
item.description:
“Fixing Empty Lists: Handling Asynchronous Data Fetching in Cloud Firestore”

Encountering an empty list when attempting to retrieve data from Cloud Firestore is a frequent challenge, particularly when dealing with asynchronous operations. This occurs because operations like fetching data don’t return immediately; they operate in the background. The core of the problem lies in attempting to use data that hasn’t finished loading yet, leading to unexpected empty collections.
